statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: burns billions and billions of dollars a year
our_interpretation: Assess the normalized prediction about survival without continuing outside funding. The separate year-end conversion prediction is outside this claim.
‘Die’ means cease operating as a going concern because it cannot finance its obligations.
‘Without continual funding’ means outside financing actually ceases, not merely that financing becomes expensive or the company continues losing money.
Conversion does not itself trigger the survival test. ‘Even if’ says conversion would not remove the claimed dependence.
criteria.support_condition: After outside financing ceases, OpenAI exhausts its available resources and ceases operating because it cannot fund its obligations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After outside financing ceases, OpenAI demonstrably becomes self-financing and continues operating without replacement outside financing. Survival for a short period on previously raised cash is insufficient.
